sources.note: Curtin University scholarships database — scholarship details page for the John Curtin Global Excellence Scholarship (awarding body's own domain, scholarships.curtin.edu.au).

awarding_body.detail: The page is hosted on Curtin University's own scholarships site (scholarships.curtin.edu.au) and is the details page for the John Curtin Global Excellence Scholarship, described as a Curtin University award.
awarding_body.quote: Through the John Curtin Global Excellence Scholarship, eligible students will receive 40% off the tuition fee for the duration of the course. Curtin University is proud to award this prestigious scholarship to students who have demonstrated exceptional academic performance and a commitment to excellence in their studies.

deadline.detail: Page shows Status: Open with applications opening 27/07/2026 and closing 1/10/2027. As of the check date (12 October 2026) this is a currently-open cycle, and the date matches the record's deadline of 1 October 2027.
deadline.quote: Status: Open / Applications open: 27/07/2026 / Applications close: 1/10/2027

eligibility.detail: Each eligibility claim in the record is confirmed: international, fee-paying, non-sponsored students of any nationality except Australian; enrolled in a Curtin undergraduate degree or Master's by coursework; studying at a Curtin Western Australian campus commencing in 2027 or 2028; CWA of 95% or equivalent in the most recent eligible course of study; and not enrolled in an excluded course or programme type.
eligibility.quote: This scholarship is only for: International, fee-paying, non-sponsored students of any nationality except Australian; and Are enrolled in a Curtin undergraduate degree course OR a Master degree by coursework; and Will be studying at a Curtin Western Australian campus (WA Campus) commencing in 2027 or 2028; and Achieved a Course-Weighted Average (CWA) of 95% or equivalent scores in your most recent and eligible course of study.

funding.detail: Funding is a tuition fee credit of 40% of the tuition fee for the scholarship term (up to 4 years undergraduate, maximum 2 years Master's by coursework) — matching the record's 'Tuition Fee Waiver (40% of tuition fee for the scholarship term)'. It is explicitly tuition-only, so it is not a fully funded award, and the record does not claim it is.
funding.quote: This scholarship provides eligible students 40% off the tuition fee of the course they are undertaking. / Provides 40% of the tuition fee of your Course, credited for up to 4 years for an undergraduate degree course OR maximum of 2 years for a Masters degree by Coursework (Scholarship term), as a tuition fee credit... / Only covers tuition fees and does not cover any other international student expense

degree_levels.detail: Course type listed as Undergraduate and Postgraduate coursework; eligible courses are all undergraduate degrees (with named exclusions) and all Master degrees by coursework only (with named exclusions), matching the record's Bachelor's, Master's.
degree_levels.quote: All undergraduate degrees, excluding the Bachelor of Science (Medical Radiation Science), Bachelor of Medicine, Bachelor of Surgery, Bachelor of Science (Advanced Nursing), Bachelor of Science (Paramedicine), Bachelor of Science (Oral Health Therapy). / All Master degrees by coursework only, excluding the Master of Taxation, Master of Dietetics, Master of Midwifery, Master of Occupational Therapy, Master of Social Work (Qualifying), Master of Clinical Physiotherapy, Master of Nursing Practice, Master of Psychology (Professional), Master of Clinical Psychology and Master of Psychology (Clinical).

recommended_field_updates.verification_notes: Verified live 12 Oct 2026 against the Curtin scholarship page (Status: Open). Cycle opens 27 Jul 2026 and closes 1 Oct 2027 — an unusually long application window, but that is the published wording. Award is tuition-only (40% tuition fee credit; up to 4 years undergraduate / 2 years for Master's by coursework) and does not cover other international student expenses. No separate scholarship application: qualifying Curtin course applications are assessed automatically. Excluded-course list may change without notice; the record's exclusions note should be read against the live list at re-check.
